shot_name: Push-in on Mom's sticky note and second bottle
setting: Interior airplane cabin, row 41, seat B, lights now on, harsh pale white, gray dawn in the window.

references.notes: Two identical small bottles. Sticky note reads: One for you. One for whoever sits next to you.

style: Gritty 1990s 35mm film look, heavy film grain, anamorphic bokeh, soft halation around lights, handheld feel, soft diffused light, raw and nostalgic. 9:16 vertical.
